output.sql:
SELECT MIN(o.order_date) AS first_completed_order_date
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.customer_id = 42
  AND o.status = 'completed';
output.explanation: This query finds the earliest order date for customer 42 among orders with status 'completed' in marts.fct_orders. I didn't use dim_customers.first_order_date because it may count orders of any status. I also assumed the status value is spelled exactly 'completed', since the schema doesn't list the allowed values. If you meant revenue-counting orders instead, filter on is_revenue = true. The result is NULL if customer 42 has no completed orders.
